task.title: Reduce spool encoding and replay cost for dense content matches
task.problem: Every matching line is converted from rg JSON into another JSON record, then parsed again per logical path sharing that blob.
task.proposal: Compare the existing temporary spool with a length-prefixed record (line number and text bytes); preserve the per-blob ranges and independently positioned readers.
acceptance: Compare text and JSON output byte for byte for shared blobs, Unicode, rg base64 events, CRLF, empty matching lines and long lines; exercise interleaved readers and cancellation across groups.
Repeat dense and sparse benchmarks; record search time, peak RSS and temporary bytes. Keep memory bounded by record size rather than match count and retain the -l fast path.
evidence: Dense shared-blob text output took 266 ms with the existing spool and 161 ms with a prototype. See https://github.com/rmorozov/bst-utilities/pull/17#pullrequestreview-6013606582 and docs/source-grep-performance.md.
